caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional, decorative object that appears to be made of ceramic or a similar material. The central feature is a round, yellow textured sphere with small bumps, suggesting the appearance of a lemon or fruit. Surrounding the sphere are five large green leaves, radiating outward symmetrically. At the front center of the yellow sphere is an oval-shaped, red element that resembles a petal or seed. The sphere and leaves are mounted on a pedestal base that is mostly yellow with a bordered red panel on its front. The panel contains a simple floral design featuring a green stem and leaves, a central black dot (the flower's center), and red petals. The base has a scalloped detail near the top, and the bottom is bordered in green. The entire shape is outlined by a fine black line, and the composition is centered within a thin black rectangular frame on a light beige background.
title: Chalkware
